name: How do I choose between a solid core and hollow core door for my basement frame?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a solid core and hollow core door for my basement frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solid core doors provide significant sound reduction and a sturdy, high-end feel, which is ideal for basement bedrooms, home theaters, and rental suites. However, they are substantially heavier and require a rigid, well-shimmed door jamb with longer screws secured through the top hinge into the wall stud. Hollow core doors are lightweight, budget-friendly, and exert minimal stress on the frame, making them adequate for utility rooms, storage closets, or laundry areas. If privacy and quiet are your priorities, solid core frames are worth the extra carpentry preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose solid core for sound dampening and durability in bedrooms and offices; choose hollow core for low-cost, light-use utility and storage rooms.
